snippet.title: The Devil's Face - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
After a long and challenging development process, we are thrilled to present the official trailer for our first horror game, The Devil's Face! You can now play the free demo and purchase the full game on the Epic Games Store, Steam, or Itch.io.

Please pay attention to the minimum PC requirements for our game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253200/The_Devils_Face/
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-devils-face-356c31
https://tzavisstudio.itch.io/the-devils-face
